fields.title: PM meeting with King of Jordan Abdullah II: 26 November 2026

main_text:
PM meeting with King of Jordan Abdullah II: 26 November 2026
The Prime Minister met His Majesty the King of Jordan, Abdullah II, this morning in Downing Street.
The Prime Minister began by underlining the depth and warmth of the UK-Jordan relationship. This relationship was going from strength to strength, with trade between the two countries continuing to grow, he said.
Beyond economic growth, the UK and Jordan were also strong security partners, the Prime Minister added. Both leaders welcomed their cooperation in this area, noting it was helping to keep citizens in both countries safe.
On tensions across the Middle East, the Prime Minister was clear that escalating violence would help no one. He set out the UK’s continued efforts to push for de-escalation alongside Jordan and other partners, to protect people at home from the knock-on effects of wider conflict.
Turning to the situation in Gaza, the two leaders agreed there was an urgent need to get more aid in. With winter fast approaching and the situation on the ground deteriorating, they committed to continuing to work together to push for greater humanitarian access.
The Prime Minister also thanked Jordan for its continued support in defending the two-state solution, as the only path to long-term regional stability. The leaders agreed to stay in close contact and to continue coordinating their efforts with international partners.
They looked forward to speaking again soon.
